spanish: Hombros hicieron a él, que se unen; sobre dos fue juntado.
grammarChanges: Removed the invented possessor and noun ("sus"/"extremos"): שְׁנֵי licenses only the dual construct numeral "two of," with no pronominal suffix and no head noun in this packet, so the construct is rendered as the bare numeral "dos."

Changed the passive adjective "juntados" to the active clause "que se unen" to match the Qal active participle (חֹבְרֹת); masculine agreement follows "Hombros," per the audit, not the Hebrew feminine noun.
readerNote: Chose the relative clause "que se unen" over a gerund to render the active participle without reintroducing a passive sense.
